product.summary: Yoroi self-custodial Cardano browser extension, now within the wallet's announced wind-down phase.
product.notes: Current Yoroi site announces a wallet wind-down, so this product is not marked active. Firefox support already ended separately; current guidance points remaining extension users to Chrome, Brave or Edge. Initial extension launch date is not inferred from the entity's 2018 history.

events.title: Yoroi Wallet transitioned to SecondFi
events.description: SecondFi announced that Yoroi Wallet had officially transitioned into SecondFi and that the existing Yoroi application would update into the SecondFi experience while preserving the user's self-custody wallet continuity.
events.notes: This is modeled as a rebrand/continuity event rather than a new wallet launch. First-party SecondFi material explicitly says the existing Yoroi wallet and app transition into SecondFi without creating a new wallet.

events.title: SecondFi security incident exploited per-transaction signature flaw
events.description: SecondFi reported that between June 21 and June 23 external attackers exploited a cryptographic flaw in per-transaction signature generation, resulting in approximately 16.1 million ADA being stolen from 374 wallets.
events.notes: The first-party incident log describes a June 21-23 incident window. WLR uses June 21 as the event_date start boundary and preserves the full window in this note rather than inventing a single exact transfer time. The root cause is described as a flaw in how wallet software generated per-transaction signatures that could expose private-key material from public transaction data.

events.title: SecondFi announced normal operations would not resume
events.description: SecondFi announced that it would not resume normal operations even after security audits and asked all users to migrate away, with the team's continuing role limited to asset recovery work.
events.notes: The July 6 first-party update is an explicit shutdown boundary for normal wallet operations, but WLR keeps the status effect conservative at deprecated because the same application remains available in quarantine/recovery modes. Canonical entity/product status remains unchanged in this batch.

evidence.title: Yoroi Terms and Conditions
evidence.notes: First-party terms define Yoroi as free open-source wallet software that does not make EMURGO or third parties custodians of user assets; the current site banner simultaneously establishes the wind-down phase.

evidence.title: Yoroi Is Now SecondFi: How to Update and Get Started
evidence.notes: First-party SecondFi announcement states that Yoroi Wallet officially transitioned into SecondFi, that the Yoroi app updates into SecondFi, and that the existing self-custody wallet remains continuous.

evidence.title: Security Incident Update
evidence.notes: Continuously updated first-party incident log. The July 22 update records the June 21-23 theft window, approximately 16.1M ADA stolen from 374 wallets, and the per-transaction-signature cryptographic flaw. The July 6 update states that normal operations will not resume and users must migrate away.
